extraction.Name: Morris Joseph Douville
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: No, I mortgaged and then sold it.
extraction.Fee Patent Date: about nine or ten years ago (circa 1919-1920)
extraction.NOTES: Has six children; in good health at time of questionnaire; was sick at time of patent delivery having just returned from Omaha where he had an operation performing removing his appendix; does not remember signing a receipt for the patent; patent was brought home to him by his brother-in-law; did not make application for the patent; received $2400 in money and a team valued at $200 for the land; not satisfied with the sale; debts were settled between him and the purchaser; subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Gross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, March 26, 1929
